summary: Tested the rewritten High-Intent Buyer Detection guided AI flow end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 14/15 tests pass, 1 skipped (patch_dismiss when no open leads — expected in shared DB). All new endpoints (/api/intent/status, /scan, /leads, /leads/{id}/analyze, /execute, /impact, PATCH) work as spec'd, including gating (401 unauth, 400 execute-before-analyze, 400 invalid recipient / invalid status, 404 unknown lead), and the 422 graceful-failure on execute-with-send is confirmed (invalid preview RESEND_API_KEY). Frontend: /discover loads for the paid owner, stats render, scan works, and the full guided flow (open dialog -> AI analyze -> Why/Prediction/Recommendation with editable artifact -> Mark done -> Outcome measurement -> Impact card) all rendered with real AI output. Activity log shows detected/analyze/execute/impact entries. Dismiss removes lead from open list, list + stats refresh. One real bug found: clicking the Copy button in the flow dialog throws an uncaught NotAllowedError that surfaces a full-screen React dev error overlay in preview.

minor.issue: Scan preserves any existing lead.status even when it is a value no longer accepted by PATCH (e.g. legacy 'sandbox' status left in DB). Not user-facing, but leaks stale schema — worth normalizing unknown statuses back to 'new' on scan-update.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() throws NotAllowedError in some browser contexts (preview iframe, non-focused). The promise rejection is unhandled, so React surfaces a full-page 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay that blocks the user from continuing the flow. Wrap in try/catch or .catch() and show a toast fallback.

action_items: Wrap copyArtifact() in try/catch (or use .catch()) so clipboard permission failures don't render an unhandled-error overlay; show a toast fallback instead.
Consider normalizing legacy/unknown lead.status values back to 'new' in the /intent/scan upsert path so stale leads (e.g. 'sandbox' from removed features) become actionable again.
critical_code_review_comments: HighIntent.js copyArtifact writes to clipboard without error handling — a common source of Sentry noise and dev-overlay in embedded contexts.

routes/intent.py scan_leads: `existing.get('status', 'new')` blindly preserves any prior status. Fine for the new state machine, but historical DB rows can hold statuses no longer in the accepted set — validate/normalize on upsert.

Analyze endpoint status transition: `new_status = 'analyzed' if lead.status == 'new' else lead.status` — subtle but means analyzing a 'dismissed' lead won't undismiss it (probably intentional). Consider making analyze idempotent w.r.t. re-analysis after dismiss.
test_high_intent.py (old file) is stale and referenced removed endpoints — should be deleted to avoid confusion (kept as-is per instructions; new test file is test_high_intent_v2.py).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of guided-flow scenarios verified; 1 UI bug on copy

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing 7 db.intent_leads rows; had to PATCH them back to status='new' between runs because prior test runs left them in won/dismissed/executed states (scan is idempotent by account_key and preserves prior status).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/test_high_intent_v2.py (junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_high_intent_v2.xml). To reset DB state for E2E: login via /api/auth/login then PATCH each /api/intent/leads/{id} to {status:'new'} — scan does NOT reset status. AI analyze always returns a valid briefing (real Claude output observed in preview). Real Resend send returns 422 by design (invalid key).
rca of the issue: Copy-button overlay bug: navigator.clipboard.writeText() returns a Promise that rejects with NotAllowedError when the document/iframe lacks clipboard-write permission or focus. HighIntent.js line ~160 calls it without awaiting or catching, so the rejection bubbles up as an unhandled promise rejection that React dev-mode renders as a blocking full-screen overlay. Fix: `try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(artifact || ''); setCopied(true); } catch (e) { toast.error('Clipboard not available — copy manually'); }`.
